title: SEG Implements Edge
description: Schema for an Implements edge in the Safety Evidence Graph. Direction: Implementation → Requirement. The implementation declares what it implements via the @implements doxygen tag. Many-to-many supported — one implementation may implement multiple requirements, one requirement may be implemented by multiple functions. Strong-propagation edge: a change to either endpoint marks this edge suspect and notifies the Software Engineer. The seg:subHashChanged field on the resulting ReviewEvent distinguishes whether api_hash or body_hash changed. Resolution requires human affirmation by the Software Engineer.

seg:from.description: IRI of the Implementation node — the function that implements.

seg:to.description: IRI of the Requirement node — the one being implemented.
